name: play_describe_says_what_a_duel_shows
description: The play harness's words (tools/play/describe.gd) for a duel say what its screen shows, on Undertow's own rules against the caretaker: the duel bar's two rows, and the Seawall's plate while the pointer is on it ('over your Seawall on the duel bar'); the Drift tray's head as it reads ('FROM WAVE 2', then 'TIER I 30 gold'), its packs by name with their keys, prices and places, a pack greyed with the reason a cork would get, never 'not now'; my bottle by the pack it holds (not its check's id) and what its socket says, with the Space key once it may be uncorked; the rival's bottles by tier. Its wave line says 'build window' only while my window is open: with my hollow cleared and the rival's wave still running it says 'waiting for the window', as the strip and the tray do, so a `wait until build window` waits for the window, and the card's greyed Ready says why. The waves to come read the creeps' numbers and the Surge's rows as drawn, and a Surge's wave line ('Surge 1/3 · build window') is among the watched lines, which a `wait until` reads (playtest halv s1: 'My wait slept through Surge 2's window').

steps.assert: resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').start(scene)
steps.msg: a duel against the caretaker

steps.assert: resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').defend(scene)
steps.msg: my seat plays its plan

steps.assert: said.begins_with('screen: match · Undertow on Wickhollow · offline') and said.contains('before wave 1 · build window · First wave in ')
steps.msg: the duel and its first window

steps.assert: said.contains('duel: You · 20 lives · 0 breach · +0 a wave · Seawall 0 (F) | Rival · 20 lives · 0 breach · +0 a wave · Seawall 0')
steps.msg: the duel bar's rows as shown

steps.assert: said.contains('drift · FROM WAVE 2: no packs to cork yet') and not said.contains('your bottles:') and not said.contains("rival's bottles:")
steps.msg: the tray's head as it reads before the Drift opens; no bottles yet

steps.assert: said.contains('waves to come') == false
steps.msg: the wave list only while it shows

steps.assert: said.contains(': over your Seawall on the duel bar') and said.contains('duel tip: Seawall (F) · F, during a wave: surf bursts up round your Holdfast') and said.contains('No charge yet. 4 more lives lost earn one.')
steps.msg: the pointer on my Seawall, and its plate's words

steps.assert: waves.contains('4 Armored: Gourdling ×8 42 hp, Thornback ×4 140 hp · armour 4 | ') and waves.contains('| The Surge, if both Holdfasts stand after wave 12: health +35% | S1 Swift/Armored: Scuttler ×16 65 hp, Thornback ×5 324 hp · armour 4 · wave 9 again | S2 ')
steps.msg: the waves to come with their numbers and the Surge's rows as drawn

steps.assert: said.contains('Wave 1/12 · build window · next in ') and said.contains('drift · TIER I 30 gold (click or 1-3 to cork): [1] %s 30 @%d,%d | [2] %s 30 @' % [names[0], at.x, at.y, names[1]]) and said.contains('| [3] %s 30 @' % names[2])
steps.msg: window 2 open for both: the tray's tier and price, each pack by name with its key, price and place

steps.assert: said.contains('[1] %s 30 @%d,%d (greyed: not enough gold)' % [names[0], at.x, at.y]) and not said.contains('not now')
steps.msg: short of gold a pack says so

steps.assert: said.contains('your bottles: %s wave 2 @' % names[0]) and not said.contains('your bottles: %s ' % Game.drift_packs()[0])
steps.msg: my bottle by the pack it holds, as its tip names it, and what its socket says

steps.assert: said.contains("rival's bottles: tier I")
steps.msg: the rival's bottle by its tier

steps.assert: said.contains('Wave 2/12 · wave running') and said.contains('your bottles: %s 2' % names[0]) and said.contains(' [Space] (lit)')
steps.msg: in its wave my bottle counts down to its own uncorking and carries the Space key

steps.assert: said.contains('drift · NEXT WINDOW: no packs to cork yet')
steps.msg: and the tray's head says the next window

steps.assert: Game.state == Game.State.PREP and Game.duel_wave()
steps.msg: my hollow cleared wave 2; the rival's still plays it

steps.assert: said.contains("Wave 2/12 · waiting for the window · your rival's wave still runs") and not watched.contains('build window')
steps.msg: no build window yet: the line says it waits, and a wait until build window keeps waiting

steps.assert: said.contains('D Ready @') and said.contains('(greyed: the window opens once both waves are over)')
steps.msg: and the greyed Ready says why

steps.assert: watched.contains('Wave 2/12 · build window · next in ')
steps.msg: once the window is open for both: the build window

steps.assert: resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').start(scene)
steps.msg: a new duel

steps.assert: resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').to_window(14)
steps.msg: both hollows to wave 12 in the first window: the next horn plays the Surge's first wave

steps.assert: watched.contains(' | Surge 1/3 · ')
steps.msg: a Surge's wave line is among the watched lines, so a wait until its window or its wave ends there
